title: Gradlew commands are constantly timing out
body:
For some reason, when Claude tries to execute my gradle commands (compiling or running tests) they always time out:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a6ea431d-de78-4359-abba-8f6e4e08b5ac)

However, when I manually execute the tests in another terminal they work just fine.
author: skerit
